posts.title: Asterisms
posts.description: Our stars are innate but not our constellations. We can draw whatever lines we want up there. We pin them up one by one deciding our futures and describing our pasts, and don’t we tell such stories? Stories of warriors and beasts, hunting dogs and sinister queens. posts.title: Eucalyptus
posts.description: I am dripping eucalyptus that scent like moths and half-moonlight. It feels like the knit beneath your sheets, and sticks clippings to the dada dancing on my skin.

posts.title: Elvish Digits
posts.description: This converts hindu-arabic numerals into elvish ones. By “elvish numerals” I mean Tengwar duodecimal in order from least magnitude to most. I just think they are neat. Enjoy!
